function: The background-position-y property sets the position of a background image on the y-axis.

defaults.Animatable: yes. Read about animatable Try it

values.function: Top side is 0% on y-axis, and bottom side is 100%. Percentage value refers to height of background positioning area minus height of background image.
Vertical distance from top side. Units can be pixels (0px) or any other CSS units.

Two value syntax, only supported in Firefox and Safari. - ypos is set either to "top" or "bottom". - offset is vertical distance from background image and "top" or "bottom" side set with ypos. Units can be pixels or any other CSS units.
Sets this property to its default value. Read about initial
